title: 简街幕后掌权者：低调交易巨头如何影响全球市场
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: If you're interested in Wall Street's money and power, by now, you've probably heard of a firm called Jane Street.
segments.zh: 如果你对华尔街的财富与权力感兴趣，到现在应该听过一家叫简街的公司。

segments.en: You might even know that it broke industry records by making $40 billion of revenue in 2025.
segments.zh: 你甚至可能知道，它在2025年创下行业纪录，营收达到400亿美元。

segments.en: Jane Street isn't just a private company. It doesn't have a chief executive officer or a board or a website that lists its top leaders. It doesn't even share some leadership information
segments.zh: 简街不只是私营公司。它没有首席执行官，没有董事会，也没有列出高管的网站。它甚至不分享部分领导层信息，

segments.en: with peers or sometimes with insiders.
segments.zh: 对同行如此，有时对内部人士也是如此。

segments.en: The question of who's who inside Jane Street isn't just a matter of Wall Street intrigue.
segments.zh: 简街内部谁是谁，不只是华尔街的八卦。

segments.en: This cast of people who help steer Jane Street matters to global economies, to markets, and to everyday investors.
segments.zh: 这群帮助掌舵简街的人，对全球经济、市场和普通市场参与者都很重要。

segments.en: If you've got money in an exchange-traded fund, it's a pretty good bet it was transacted by Jane Street.
segments.zh: 如果你持有交易所交易产品，那很可能就是简街经手的。

segments.en: Around the world, the scale of Wall Street's gains and even a historic loss tied to the AI fund situation awareness have put the firm in a bright spotlight.
segments.zh: 在全球范围内，华尔街的收益规模，甚至与AI基金情况认知相关的历史性亏损，都把这家公司推到了聚光灯下。

segments.en: So we spent months using regulatory filings, interviews, court records, tax returns, and corporate materials to figure out who's making decisions inside one of Wall Street's most
segments.zh: 所以我们花了几个月，利用监管文件、采访、法庭记录、税务申报和公司材料，来弄清楚华尔街最具

segments.en: dominant trading houses. The answer is a group of prestigious, nerdy, and elusive executives.
segments.zh: 主导地位的交易机构之一内部谁在做决策。答案是一群有声望、书呆子气又难以捉摸的高管。

segments.en: Many of them graduated from high school math clubs into the Ivy League.
segments.zh: 他们中许多人从高中数学俱乐部一路走进常春藤名校。

segments.en: Most are white men. At least two have own golf or tennis clubs.
segments.zh: 大多是白人男性。至少两人拥有自己的高尔夫或网球俱乐部。

segments.en: More than one wrote a textbook. And none are particularly well-known.
segments.zh: 不止一人写过教科书。而他们都不太为人所知。
